nodes.label: Quick Reference — Full Rule Set (all 10 categories)
Common Rules for Professional UI + Pre-Delivery Checklist
Accessibility (CRITICAL) rules
nodes.rationale: Critical accessibility rules covering contrast, focus, keyboard, screen readers, ARIA, WCAG 2.2 A/AA/AAA criteria, and non-text contrast.

nodes.label: Touch & Interaction (CRITICAL) rules
nodes.rationale: Critical touch and interaction rules covering target size, spacing, hover/tap, gestures, feedback, safe areas, and system gesture conventions.

nodes.label: Performance (HIGH) rules
nodes.rationale: HIGH-priority performance rules covering image/font optimization, CSS/JS loading, reflow reduction, lazy loading, main-thread budget, and offline support.

nodes.label: Style Selection (HIGH) rules
nodes.rationale: HIGH-priority style rules covering product-style matching, consistency, emoji avoidance, platform adaptation, state clarity, elevation, dark-mode pairing, icon style, system controls, blur purpose, and primary action.

nodes.label: Layout & Responsive (HIGH) rules
nodes.rationale: HIGH-priority layout rules covering viewport meta, mobile-first design, breakpoints, font size, line length, scroll behavior, spacing scale, container width, z-index, and content priority.

nodes.label: Typography & Color (MEDIUM) rules
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM-priority typography and color rules covering line height/length, font pairing/scale, contrast readability, semantic/dark-mode color tokens, accessible pairs, truncation, spacing, and tabular figures.

nodes.label: Animation (MEDIUM) rules
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM-priority animation rules covering duration/timing, transform performance, easing, motion meaning, state transitions, continuity, spring physics, staggering, shared-element transitions, interruptibility, and modal/navigation motion.

nodes.label: Forms & Feedback (MEDIUM) rules
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM-priority form and feedback rules covering labels, error placement/recovery, submit feedback, validation, input types, autofill, undo, toast/confirmation dialogs, field grouping, focus management, and error summaries.

nodes.label: Navigation Patterns (HIGH) rules
nodes.rationale: HIGH-priority navigation rules covering bottom nav limits, drawers, back behavior, deep linking, tab bars/app bars, labels/icons, active state, hierarchy, modal escape, search, breadcrumbs, state preservation, gesture nav, badges, overflow menus, and destructive nav separation.

nodes.label: Charts & Data (LOW) rules
nodes.rationale: LOW-priority chart and data rules covering chart type, accessible color guidance, data tables, patterns/textures, legends, tooltips, axis labels, responsive charts, empty/loading states, large datasets, number formatting, touch targets, and screen-reader summaries.

nodes.label: Icons & Visual Elements rules
nodes.rationale: Professional UI rules for icons and visual elements: no emoji as structural icons, vector-only assets, contextual semantics, stable interaction states, correct brand logos, consistent sizing, stroke consistency, filled vs outline discipline, touch targets, alignment, and contrast.

nodes.label: Interaction (App) rules
nodes.rationale: Professional mobile app interaction rules covering tap feedback, animation timing, accessibility focus, disabled state clarity, touch target minimum, gesture conflict prevention, and semantic native controls.

nodes.label: Light/Dark Mode Contrast rules
nodes.rationale: Professional light/dark mode rules covering surface readability, text contrast in both themes, border/divider visibility, state contrast parity, token-driven theming, and scrim/modal legibility.

nodes.label: Layout & Spacing rules
nodes.rationale: Professional layout and spacing rules covering safe-area compliance, system bar clearance, consistent content width, 8dp spacing rhythm, readable text measure, section spacing hierarchy, adaptive gutters, and scroll/fixed element coexistence.

nodes.label: Pre-Delivery Checklist
nodes.rationale: Canonical pre-delivery checklist for app UI delivery covering process steps, visual quality, interaction, light/dark mode, layout, and accessibility verification before shipping.

nodes.label: Pre-Delivery Checklist — Process
nodes.rationale: Process steps before delivery: run relevant UX searches, review quick-reference §1–§3, test on 375px and landscape, verify reduced-motion and Dynamic Type, check dark mode contrast independently, confirm touch targets and safe areas.

nodes.label: Pre-Delivery Checklist — Visual Quality
nodes.rationale: Visual quality checklist: no emoji icons, consistent icon family, official brand assets with correct proportions, pressed-state visuals without layout shift, semantic theme tokens without hardcoded colors.

nodes.label: Pre-Delivery Checklist — Interaction
nodes.rationale: Interaction checklist: pressed feedback on all tappables, touch targets meet minimum size, shared platform-appropriate micro-interaction timing, clear disabled states, screen reader focus order matches visual order, no nested/conflicting gesture regions.

nodes.label: Pre-Delivery Checklist — Light/Dark Mode
nodes.rationale: Light/dark mode checklist: primary text contrast >=4.5:1 in both themes, dividers and interaction states distinguishable in both modes, modal/drawer scrim measured against real background, both themes tested before delivery.

nodes.label: Pre-Delivery Checklist — Layout
nodes.rationale: Layout checklist: safe areas respected for headers/tab bars/bottom CTAs, scroll content not hidden behind fixed bars, verified on small/large phone and tablet portrait+landscape, horizontal insets adapt by size/orientation, 4/8dp spacing rhythm maintained, readable long-form text measure.

nodes.label: Pre-Delivery Checklist — Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Accessibility checklist: decorative icons hidden from a11y tree, meaningful images/icons have text alternatives, icon controls have accessible names and state, form fields have labels/hints/errors, color not the only indicator, reduced motion and dynamic text supported, sticky UI does not obscure focus, drag/swipe have alternatives, authentication allows password managers, auto-rotating content has pause/stop, failed forms retain inline errors with error summary.
